work.title: Adivasi women’s movements in eastern India: south Bihar and Jharkhand since the 1980s
work.author: Marilena Proietti
work.institution: Università degli Studi di Roma La Sapienza

verified_manifestations.repository: Deposito legale delle tesi di dottorato / Sapienza

scope_verified_from_repository_metadata.geographic_scope: eastern India, especially former southern Bihar and contemporary Jharkhand
scope_verified_from_repository_metadata.temporal_scope: from the 1980s to the present as described in the thesis abstract

deduplication.decision: canonicalize the legal-deposit and IRIS records as manifestations of one thesis work
deduplication.basis: same author, exact title, year, institution and identical thesis filename; separate persistent handles are retained as manifestation locators
deduplication.do_not_merge_with: interviews, field notes, recordings, participant data, community records, later papers or other works merely because they may be related to the thesis

rights_governance_boundary.rule: Open access and a generic Creative Commons label do not establish the exact reuse permissions for every thesis component or participant-derived material. Do not ingest quotations, images, interviews, field materials, personal data or culturally sensitive content until exact licence terms, provenance and cultural-access/consent gates are resolved.

release_effect.reason: This run strengthens identity/deduplication/rights provenance for a previously observed candidate. Permanent promotion awaits master-register reconciliation and exact licence/content-level review.
